headline: Congress renamed a post office in Zapata, Texas, as the Zapata Veterans Post Office.
what_it_does: This law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 810 N US Highway 83 in Zapata, Texas, the Zapata Veterans Post Office. It changes only the name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2016, and the name took effect when it was signed.
